Name: Truffle Recipes
Author: dragonsir
Description:
[size=5]May not be currently compatible with 1.6 Update:[/size]

I am currently working on all of my mods to make them compatible with 1.6. Please use at your own risk or wait until a compatible version is available.


[line]


Makes truffles a cooking ingredient for 3 new recipes: roasted truffles, truffle alfredo, and truffle fries. I may add more recipes in future updates. The recipes can be purchased from Marnie at any time. As she is infamous for not always being available at her ranch, I may change that if anyone requests it.

UPDATE: I have added 2 new recipes: Truffle Kulfi and Truffle Pizza! Kulfi is a frozen dairy desert, very similar to ice cream, that is popular in India. And who doesn't love more pizza?


[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Install the latest version of JSON assets.[/url]﻿
[*]Download ONE of the main files of this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
